title: Realize arbitrary positive rational activities by weak-reversible cycle flows
statement: On any fixed weakly reversible complex graph choose positive rational cycle-circulation flows q_r, and for any positive rational activity vector lambda set kappa_r=q_r/lambda^y_r. At each complex, kappa_r lambda^y_r=q_r, so incoming and outgoing fluxes balance exactly. These positive rational rates give complex balance at lambda without changing the enabled reaction structure or its actual reachability classes. This includes genuinely nonconservative complex-balanced equilibria. It does not assert that arbitrary preexisting non-balanced rates have the conditioned product-Poisson law, and does not construct the new uniform finite/infinite-class sampler.

evidence.quote: ROOT ORIGINAL feasibility calculation for a DIFFERENT FULL uniform inference question: write W_lambda(x)=prod lambda_i^x_i/x_i!, F=-logW. For complete binary lengthL, choose integer A>=2+L+d+sum lambda_i+sum x0_i+ceil(log(100d/epsilon)), computable with rational rounding. Then F(x0)<=2A^2 (enlarging fixed numerical constants), sum lambda_i<=A, and for U=100A^3 the unrestricted Poisson Chernoff bound gives sum_{max x_i>=U} W_lambda(x)/W_lambda(x0) <=d*exp(A+2A^2)*(eA/U)^U<epsilon/100. Since Z_Gamma>=W_lambda(x0), this is a valid absolute-tail-to-CONDITIONAL-mass bound even for exponentially rare classes, with O(L) bits to encode U. Truncating the cube does NOT replace original reachability by connectivity inside the cube. Separately, positive-real log-Gamma remainder after orderr is <=|B_2r|/[2r(2r-1)t^(2r-1)]; using |B_2r|<=4(2r)!/(2pi)^(2r), t>=8r gives geometric-in-r error. This supplies an actual accuracy-bit opening beyond072's 1/n approximation; it does not yet supply the complete uniform support/compiler/mixture proof. For any weakly reversible structure and positive rational lambda, choose positive rational cycle-circulation q_r on its complex graph and kappa_r=q_r/lambda^y_r; complex balance atlambda follows. Thus the new conditioned-Poisson question includes genuinely nonconservative complex-balanced equilibria, rather than claiming arbitrary original non-balanced rates have that law.
